The connected genus-three construction has exact observation Gramian T*pi^*g, completeness, curvature -1/T, both stated fixed-normalization bounds and exactly two states for every attained history at every fixed T>0. The original qualified manifold target is retained; no strengthened Euclidean-domain, firstness or human-refereeing claim. Actual Krener/Nash/Hatcher interfaces and finite native evidence were checked; no defect, repair or narrowing found. Version 1.0 and 5 October 2026 are actually printed. All nine original assets/order/rights are preserved. Private article and separate fact review passed; live publication is pending, canonical remains blank. No qualifying follow-up.
